team.name: Ibrahim Mohammed
team.bio: Ibrahim founded Startup Jigawa in Dutse in 2017. He guides the organisation's strategy, partnerships with government agencies and development partners, and overall operations under CAC RC 7256149.

team.name: Amina Aliyu Sani
team.role: Director of Programs & Digital Skills Academy
team.bio: Amina leads our Digital Skills Academy and manages student admissions. She has coordinated training delivery for major state and national initiatives, including 3MTT and the Nigeria Jubilee Fellows Programme across Jigawa.

team.name: Usman Farouk
team.bio: Usman leads software development and technology projects at Startup Jigawa. He directs our engineering team in building practical digital tools—such as RentHouse, SoftDeliver, PrepAI, and Yankasuwa—designed for local users and low-connectivity environments.

team.name: Fatima Bello Garba
team.bio: Fatima manages our civic technology projects and field research across Jigawa's 27 Local Government Areas. She coordinates community surveys, research publications, and our ongoing collaboration with the Open Government Partnership (OGP) in Jigawa.

partners.name: Federal Ministry of Communications & Digital Economy

programs.title: Digital Skills Academy - Software Engineering Diploma
programs.summary: 9-month intensive diploma covering foundational coding, modern web frameworks, database administration, and team delivery.
programs.description: A comprehensive curriculum tailored to real industry demand, offering mentorship from active senior engineers.

programs.title: Three Million Technical Talent (3MTT) Jigawa Cohort
programs.summary: Strategic in-state training co-delivered with NITDA and FMCIDE to build practical digital skills for youth across all 27 LGAs.
programs.description: National initiative providing technical training in software development, cloud computing, and digital product design.

programs.title: Civic Tech & Open Government Innovation Fellowship
programs.summary: 6-month applied fellowship pairing local researchers and technologists with state ministries to build civic transparency tools.
programs.description: Focused on budget tracking, citizen feedback mechanisms, and open data portals in collaboration with OGP Jigawa.

programs.title: AgriTech & Climate Resilience Innovation Sprint
programs.summary: Intensive 8-week acceleration sprint for innovators designing digital tools for farmers and water management across Jigawa.
programs.description: Supporting local developers and agri-businesses with technical prototyping, field testing, and mentorship.

opportunities.title: Software Engineering & Cloud Bootcamp 2026
opportunities.summary: 12-week intensive hands-on software development training covering full-stack web development and cloud deployment.
opportunities.eligibility: Residents of Jigawa State aged 18-35 with basic computer literacy.

opportunities.title: Civic Tech & Open Governance Fellowship
opportunities.summary: 6-month paid fellowship working with local communities and civil society organisations to design budget monitoring tools.
opportunities.eligibility: Researchers, policy advocates, and software designers in Northern Nigeria.

opportunities.title: Data Analysis & AI Readiness Internship
opportunities.summary: Practical 16-week placement for university graduates to build data pipelines and analytics dashboards.
opportunities.eligibility: Recent graduates (2023-2026) with backgrounds in STEM or statistics.

settings.address: Innovation Hub Complex, Kiyawa Road, Dutse, Jigawa State, Nigeria

hero.title: Building Practical Skills, Supporting Local Ideas, and Strengthening Communities in Jigawa
hero.description: Startup Jigawa is a technology and innovation centre in Dutse. Over the past nine years, we have trained more than 50,000 people in practical digital skills, built technology tools for local challenges, and collaborated with government and community partners across the state.
